SERVICE TAX ACT 2018

SERVICE TAX (PERSONS EXEMPTED FROM PAYMENT OF TAX) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 34(1) of the
Service Tax Act 2018 [Act 807], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)  This o rder may be cited as the Service Tax ( Persons Exempted from
Payment of Tax) Order 2018.

 (2)  This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2019.

Exemption from payment of service tax
3. The persons specified in column (2) of the Schedule are exempted from payment
of service tax on taxable service specified in column (3) of the Schedule subject to
conditions specified in column (4) of the Schedule.
